notes: On 4 March 2021, at night, around 50 persons, including independent professionals of the cultural sector occupied the Odeon theatre in Paris. They called denounced the impossibility to carry out their professional activity for a year, amid the coronavirus-restriction implemented by the government, called for financial assistance and demanded clear information on the conditions of reopening of cultural centers.
evidence: against coronavirus restrictions on cultural activity

notes: On 24 March 2025, a protest was organized in Tetovo demanding responsibility for the tragic accident that took place a couple of days earlier where 59 people were killed and 150 when a pyrotechnic device went off in a club and set it on fire. notes: On 20 May 2025, at the call of La Union local government (PP), around 200 residents of La Union protested outside the Ministry of Ecological Transition in Madrid - Centro (Madrid) to demand the regeneration of the Portman Bay, which was previously used as a mining wasteland, instead of sealing it off, citing environmental concerns. Protesters demanded compliance with the 2006 restoration agreement.
